limitations: The deposit does not state which clone code is POLE4-dTAG only versus MCM2-2A/POLE4-dTAG; genotype was deliberately not assigned to clone codes.
129/Ola is given in the submitter's prose but is not resolved by the validator's offline NCBITaxon lookup, so validation reports an ontology warning.

The deposit describes propionylation of histone lysines during preparation but does not provide an explicit per-search modification parameter list for the Skyline quantification; modification parameters were not inferred.
DMSO is retained as the run-label treatment/control term; the deposit calls it the untreated comparison and does not quantify the vehicle dose.
